timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: 1,368.6 KRW/USD (approaching 1,400)

WHY: The won is currently weak and weakening further—the rate has risen 5 consecutive trading days and is approaching the 1,400 level, meaning you need more KRW to buy each dollar. However, one analyst predicts the won is "still undervalued" and will reverse downward after this short-term bounce, suggesting better rates may come soon.

TIP: Consider delaying or reducing this month's conversion if possible, since the trend suggests the won may strengthen (lower KRW/USD rate) in the near term, making your $2,000 cheaper to buy.
